title: A dataset of questions on decision-theoretic reasoning in Newcomb-like problems
reasoning: The paper focuses on decision-theoretic reasoning (rationality, EDT vs. CDT) rather than morality or ethics. Although it touches on topics like the Prisoner's Dilemma and cooperation, which have ethical overlap, the authors categorize these as 'attitude' questions within decision theory and explicitly distinguish their work from 'ethics and politics' benchmarks in the related work and conclusion.
